title: Nonvanishing of top local cohomology of a Noetherian local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak n)$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], meaning that $\mathfrak n$ is its unique maximal ideal, with finite Krull dimension $d=\dim\operatorname{Spec}R\geq0$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For an $R$-module $M$, put $\Gamma_{\mathfrak n}(M)=\{x\in M:\mathfrak n^nx=0\text{ for some }n\geq1\}$ and $H^j_{\mathfrak n}(M)=R^j\Gamma_{\mathfrak n}(M)$. Then $H^d_{\mathfrak n}(R)\ne0$.
